## Personal Finance Visualization Plan

Use these three charts to show where your money goes, how it breaks down by category, and how your balance changes over the month. The data suggests housing and savings are the biggest drivers of your monthly plan.

## Chart Set and Data

### Monthly Bar Chart
Purpose: compare spending amounts across categories.

Category | Amount (USD)
Rent | 1450
Groceries | 520
Dining | 260
Transport | 180
Utilities | 140
Subscriptions | 75
Entertainment | 110
Healthcare | 90
Savings | 800
Miscellaneous | 120

### Category Pie Chart
Purpose: show the share of each category in your monthly budget.

Category | Share of Total
Rent | 40.1%
Savings | 22.1%
Groceries | 14.4%
Dining | 7.2%
Transport | 5.0%
Utilities | 3.9%
Miscellaneous | 3.3%
Entertainment | 3.0%
Healthcare | 2.5%
Subscriptions | 2.1%

### Cash-Flow Trend Line
Purpose: track cumulative cash flow across the month.

Period | Net Cash Flow (USD) | Cumulative Balance (USD)
Start | 0 | 0
After Rent | -1450 | -1450
After Groceries | -520 | -1970
After Dining | -260 | -2230
After Transport | -180 | -2410
After Utilities | -140 | -2550
After Subscriptions | -75 | -2625
After Entertainment | -110 | -2735
After Healthcare | -90 | -2825
After Miscellaneous | -120 | -2945
After Savings | -800 | -3745

## What the Charts Reveal

- **Rent dominates** the budget at about 40%, so housing is your main fixed cost.
- **Savings are substantial** at about 22%, which is a strong sign of intentional money management.
- **Variable spending is moderate**: groceries, dining, transport, and miscellaneous together add up to a meaningful but still controlled share.
- The **cash-flow line trends steadily downward**, showing that the month is expense-heavy unless income is added elsewhere.
- If you want a clearer financial picture, pair these charts with a separate **income chart** so the net surplus or deficit is visible.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Make Chart Plan] https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+build+monthly+bar+pie+and+line+charts+in+excel
Action: [Button: Budget Template] https://www.google.com/search?q=personal+finance+budget+template+spreadsheet

## Sources

- Budgeting and chart design reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel
- Pie chart best practices: https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/pie-charts/
